BESSENT: FED SHOULD STAY ON HOLD AMID IRAN WAR

US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent says the Fed should “wait and see” on rate cuts as the Iran war keeps inflation risks elevated, including from the Strait of Hormuz disruption.

He expects cuts eventually, but says uncertainty

items.headline:
BREAKING: US March PPI inflation rises to 4.0%, its highest since February 2023.

Core PPI inflation was unchanged, at 3.8%, also the highest since February 2023.

We are now officially seeing inflation metrics in the US that are at 4% or higher.

Inflation is back.
